## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm run check` passes in the changed plugin(s)
- [ ] `npm run check:repo` passes
- [ ] Shared code changed in `kit/` (not in the GENERATED copies) and `npm run kit:sync` was run
- [ ] The plugin's `CHANGELOG.md` is updated if users will notice the change
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or options changed
- [ ] Admin strings added to both `en.json` and `pl.json`
